name: Fried egg
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: Fried egg was released on October 8th, 2021, for purchase in a special bundle only available until the 11th of the month.[1]

It could be purchased as part of a larger bundle costing 19 990 ; the bundle was named "Ultra Pack" and apart from the paint, also came with 300x Ultra Containers, and unlock a protection module slot.
